mapper.select: SELECT pt.product_id, pt.task_id, pt.origin_start_time, pt.origin_end_time, pt.change_start_time, pt.change_end_time, pt.origin_charge_id, pt.change_chrge_id FROM project_plan_task pt LEFT JOIN project_plan pp ON pt.project_plan_id=pp.id WHERE PP.product_id=#{productId} AND PP.status!=#{status}

SELECT pt.product_id, pt.task_id, pt.origin_start_time AS planStartTime, pt.origin_end_time AS planEndTime, pt.origin_charge_id AS chargeId FROM project_plan_task pt WHERE pt.product_id=#{productId} AND pt.project_plan_id IN ( SELECT id FROM project_plan WHERE product_id=#{productId} AND type=#{projectPlanType} AND is_deleted=false )

SELECT id AS taskId,charge_id ,charge_name, plan_start_time,plan_end_time,product_id, status,name AS taskName FROM project_task WHERE product_id=#{productId} AND schedule_status=#{scheduleStatus} AND pid='0'
AND name LIKE concat('%',#{taskName},'%')

SELECT ppt."id", ppt.task_id, ppt.origin_start_time, ppt.origin_end_time, ppt.change_start_time, ppt.change_end_time, pt."name", pt.property, pt.status, pt.schedule_status, pt.schedule_type, pt.work_period FROM "project_plan_task" ppt LEFT JOIN project_task pt ON ppt.task_id = pt."id" WHERE ppt.is_deleted = FALSE and ppt.id in
#{item}
